asteroids.parquet.credit: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database (JPL Solar System Dynamics), courtesy NASA/JPL-Caltech
asteroids.parquet.terms: No license stated: the SBDB Query API's documentation (ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/doc/sbdb_query.html) gives no terms of use. JPL's use policy (jpl.nasa.gov/jpl-image-use-policy) covers its images and video, free for any purpose with the credit line "Courtesy NASA/JPL-Caltech"; the credit follows it. Checked 2026-11-01.
asteroids.parquet.writer: DuckDB v1.4.5, ZSTD, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 30720, sorted by spkid
notes: columns: spkid BIGINT, full_name VARCHAR, class VARCHAR, neo BOOLEAN, pha BOOLEAN, H DOUBLE, diameter DOUBLE, albedo DOUBLE, a DOUBLE, e DOUBLE, first_obs DATE

ghcn-2025-tmax.parquet.credit: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, GHCN-Daily: daily highs of 2025, cut from its data (not NOAA's unaltered data)
ghcn-2025-tmax.parquet.citation: Menne, M.J., I. Durre, B. Korzeniewski, S. McNeill, K. Thomas, X. Yin, S. Anthony, R. Ray, R.S. Vose, B.E. Gleason, and T.G. Houston, 2012: Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (GHCN-Daily), Version 3.35. NOAA National Climatic Data Center. doi:10.7289/V5D21VHZ, accessed 2026-11-02. Overview: Menne et al., 2012, J. Atmos. Oceanic Technol., 29, 897-910, doi:10.1175/JTECH-D-11-00103.1.
ghcn-2025-tmax.parquet.terms: CC0 1.0 for NOAA data disseminated through NODD (the AWS Open Data Registry's noaa-ghcn entry). NOAA asks for attribution, no implied endorsement, and that modified data not be called original or unaltered; NCEI's record (gov.noaa.ncdc:C00861) asks for its citation with the version and access date. Checked 2026-11-02.
ghcn-2025-tmax.parquet.writer: DuckDB v1.4.5, ZSTD, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 2048, sorted by latitude (north first), then station ID
notes: TMAX with no QFLAG, stations with at least 300 such days; °C (the tenths over 10); NULL where a day has none
columns: Station VARCHAR, Place VARCHAR, Latitude DOUBLE, then "Jan 1" … "Dec 31" DOUBLE (368 in all)

market-instruments.parquet.credit: Fictional instruments, the observatory's own: synthetic
market-instruments.parquet.terms: The observatory's own, made up for market watch and dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0). The names and symbols are fictional: prep fails if a symbol is listed on a US exchange (NASDAQ Trader's nasdaqlisted.txt and otherlisted.txt, fetched at each build).
market-instruments.parquet.writer: DuckDB v1.4.5, ZSTD, one row group, in the feed's order
notes: the open as the table draws it: each price the instrument's reference, no change, sizes and volume 0; the feed (seeded, synthetic) moves them
columns: Symbol VARCHAR, Name VARCHAR, Last DOUBLE, Change DOUBLE, Change % DOUBLE, Bid DOUBLE, Ask DOUBLE, Bid size INTEGER, Ask size INTEGER, Volume BIGINT, High DOUBLE, Low DOUBLE

nasa-http-jul95.parquet.source: https://ita.ee.lbl.gov/traces/NASA_access_log_Jul95.gz (NASA-HTTP, July 1995: the Kennedy Space Center's web server log)
nasa-http-jul95.parquet.credit: NASA-HTTP: Jim Dumoulin, NASA Kennedy Space Center; contributed by Martin Arlitt and Carey Williamson, University of Saskatchewan
nasa-http-jul95.parquet.terms: The Internet Traffic Archive's NASA-HTTP page (ita.ee.lbl.gov/html/contrib/NASA-HTTP.html): Restrictions, "The traces may be freely redistributed."; Privacy, "The logs fully preserve the originating host and HTTP request. Please do not however attempt any analysis beyond general traffic patterns."; Acknowledgements, "The logs was collected by Jim Dumoulin of the Kennedy Space Center, and contributed by Martin Arlitt [an address] and Carey Williamson [an address] of the University of Saskatchewan." (their addresses left out here). No named license: the data rule admits an explicit grant to redistribute (docs/DECISIONS.md, "Scenarios", 2026-11-06). Checked 2026-11-07.
nasa-http-jul95.parquet.writer: DuckDB v1.4.5, ZSTD, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 30720, in the log's order (its time's)
notes: the host dropped, every query string cut, a request holding '@' or a '~' path not served (status 400 or more) dropped, lines that don't parse dropped (prep-nasa.sql, docs/DECISIONS.md, "Scenarios")
time is the log's wall time (-0400) as a zoneless TIMESTAMP; bytes NULL where the log has "-"
columns: time TIMESTAMP, request VARCHAR, status USMALLINT, bytes UINTEGER
